# Power classes

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/power-classes.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The combat-strength profiles: power meter, stamina, how long stuns and knock-downs last, and the AI's block,
counter and attack timing. `CfgPowerClass(class, ...)` fills a 0x44-byte record at `0x006619a0 + class × 0x44`.
An AI human uses the class its character type's `CfgChar` gives (`v11d`, copied to human `+0x1b8`); a player uses
`+0x1b9`, the same class except for a Warriors type (category 14), which gets its Warrior's class, 58-66, by
character type (`0x00222ba8`), or 7 for a Warriors type with none ([Warrior classes](warrior-classes.md)).

Each difficulty script (`config_easy`, `config_normal`, `config_hard`, `config_fury`, and `config_rumble` for Rumble)
sets every class when its `CfgDifficulty` runs, and re-runs `CfgChar` for 63 types, so a type's class can differ by
difficulty; `config_preload2.lua` sets normal's at boot. The readers of each field:
[Characters: power classes](../research/characters.md#power-classes).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every class each difficulty sets is listed with every argument: 51 classes (0-10, 13-66 with gaps), 50 in Rumble.
    Every script sets class 39 twice; the second call wins and is the one listed. The boot set equals normal's and is
    not listed again. Fields marked *not traced* are stored, but no reader was found.

254 entries. Data: `research/references/power-classes.yaml`.
